title: Account plan
description: The account the plan is for, the people it maps and the plays it recommends, so a later step can act on them without reading the document. Every required field is stated: the value from the work, copied exactly, or null when there is none. Nothing is made up. A run about one account returns `scope: "account"` with its people and plays. A run about a segment, a cohort or a list of accounts returns `scope: "cohort"` with the cohort's members and tiers and its plays by tier, and no people: the people come from the plan for each account.

scope.description: What the plan is about: one account, or a cohort of accounts.

accountName.description: The account's name. Null for a cohort plan.

summary.description: The plan's point in two or three sentences.

stakeholders.description: One row per person the plan maps. Empty when none could be found. Empty for a cohort plan.

persona.description: The library persona this person matches, by name.

role.description: Their part in a decision, from the evidence; unknown when it does not say.

profileUrl.description: The person's public profile link, as a tool returned it.

email.description: Only an address a tool returned; never guessed.

angle.description: One sentence on what to say to this person and why.

plays.description: One row per recommended play, in the order to run them.

audience.description: Who the play is aimed at: a person, a persona or a team.

message.description: What the play says, in one or two sentences.

timing.description: When to run it, in words.

tier.description: For a cohort plan, the tier the play is for. Null for an account plan.

cohort.description: The cohort a cohort plan is about. Null for an account plan.

name.description: What the cohort is, in a few words.

sharedAngle.description: The one angle the cohort shares, in a sentence.

members.description: The accounts in the cohort, one row each.

tier.description: The tier the plan puts the account in.

reason.description: Why it belongs in the cohort, in a sentence.
